test_title: PYST 194: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 7th Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

a _ b _ _ c _ _ b b a c _ _ b_ a c a a b

options.text: a b a a b b a b
a c b b a b c a
a b a a a a a b
b c a a b b c c

solution:
Given sequence: a _ b _ _ c _ _ b b a c _ _ b_ a c a a b

 
• a b a a b b a b → a **a** b **b a** c - **a b** b b a c - **b a** b **b** a c - a a b
 
• a c b b a b c a → a **a** b **c b** c - **b a** b b a c - **b c**
